description: setup-julia's `version:` input accepts a partial version and resolves it to the newest matching release at run time, so `1.13` keeps picking up 1.13.x patches without a PR.

Renovate's built-in julia-actions/setup-julia rule sets no extractVersion, so the raw tag (`v1.13.0`) would land in the workflow and pin the patch. Capturing major.minor restores the original granularity.
The trailing `\.\d+$` is what excludes prereleases: `v1.13.0-rc4` must not match, or it would be rewritten to a stable-looking `1.13` (non-matching releases are dropped, not passed through).
